Summary of GPS Location Verification Improvements

The GPS verification engine and learner interface have been improved to provide high-precision telemetry, transparent feedback, and actionable guidance without weakening the 30-metre accuracy threshold or 100-metre campus geofence.

Key Improvements Made

  1. Browser Geolocation API Configuration:

    • enableHighAccuracy: true

    • timeout: 20000 (extended from 10s to 20s to allow hardware GNSS chips sufficient time to acquire satellite fixes)

    • maximumAge: 0 (guarantees fresh, real-time telemetry rather than stale cached positions)

  2. Distinct, Actionable Status Messaging:

    • Location Permission Denied: Clarifies that permission was blocked and directs learners to click the lock/tune icon in their browser address bar to enable Location.

    • Location Unavailable: Informs learners that their device cannot detect its location and prompts them to verify system location services.

    • GPS Timeout: Clarifies that the 20-second satellite acquisition timed out and prompts a retry.

    • Accuracy Insufficient: Shows the exact accuracy in metres compared to the ≤30 m threshold, explaining why it was flagged.

    • Location Successfully Verified: Confirms the learner is within the 100 m geofence of DynamicDNA Campus with acceptable accuracy.

    • Outside Workplace Radius: Reports the detected place name and indicates the distance exceeds the 100 m campus radius.

  3. Telemetry & Real-Time Accuracy Display:

    • Displays the actual GPS accuracy in metres (e.g., ±14 metres (≤30m threshold met ✅) or ±48 metres (exceeds ≤30m threshold ⚠️)).

    • Shows an active acquiring spinner (Acquiring GPS Telemetry (up to 20s)...) during coordinate acquisition.

  4. In-Card Retry Verification:

    • When accuracy is insufficient, or when a timeout or unavailable reading occurs, a dedicated "Retry Location Verification" button appears directly within the status card so the learner can retry immediately without reloading the page.

  5. Independent Backend & Service Validation:

    • Frontend & Service Level: attendanceVerificationService enforces both independent distance recalculation and the 30 m accuracy ceiling.

    • Server Level (server.ts): The /api/attendance/clock-in endpoint independently re-validates the submitted accuracy evidence and recalculates the Haversine distance, rejecting any attempts with accuracy > 30 m or distance > 100 m with HTTP 400.

    • Manual Clock-In Integrity: Successful verification never triggers an automatic clock-in; clock-in remains an intentional, manual action unlocked only after passing verification.

Why Desktop Browsers Provide Less Accurate Readings Than Mobile Devices

FactorDesktop / Laptop BrowsersMobile Devices (Smartphones / Cellular Tablets)
HardwareLaptops and PCs almost never include dedicated satellite GPS chips (GNSS receivers).Include dedicated multi-constellation satellite chips (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou).
Positioning MethodRely on Wi-Fi BSSID mapping and ISP IP address routing tables.Utilize Assisted GPS (A-GPS), cellular tower triangulation, and satellite ephemeris data.
Typical AccuracyUsually ±40 m to ±500 m (and often worse on cellular dongles, VPNs, or satellite internet).Typically ±3 m to ±15 m outdoors with a clear view of the sky.
Environmental ImpactIndoor reflection and office Wi-Fi multi-pathing heavily degrade accuracy estimations.Capable of locking directly onto orbiting satellites even through standard windows.

Learner tip included in the interface: When using a laptop on campus, moving closer to an open window or connecting to the local campus Wi-Fi network improves positioning accuracy. Alternatively, learners can log into SmartRegister on their mobile device for direct hardware GPS verification.

Verification

  • Automated Tests: All 97 unit tests passing (Attendance Terminal validation, Admin Reports, Reverse Geocoding, Enhanced GPS Accuracy Telemetry, and In-App Password Reset).

  • Compilation & Linting: Built and verified with zero TypeScript or lint errors.

Dependency Resolution & Build Report

1. Root Cause Analysis

During npm install on Vercel, npm reported an ERESOLVE error tracing through:

  • vite: ^8.3.0 (resolving to vite@8.3.7)

  • @tailwindcss/vite: ^4.3.3 (peer dependency vite: ^5.2.0 || ^6 || ^7 || ^8)

  • @vitejs/plugin-react: ^6.1.1 (peer dependency vite: ^8.0.0)

While the error trace mentioned vite, @tailwindcss/vite, and @vitejs/plugin-react, the actual conflicting dependency was esbuild:

  • package.json had "esbuild": "^0.25.0" pinned in devDependencies.

  • vite@8.3.7 requires an optional peer dependency of esbuild: "^0.27.0 || ^0.28.0".

  • Because the root project pinned esbuild@0.25.x, npm’s strict peer resolution algorithm flagged a conflict between the root project's esbuild@0.25.x and vite’s requirement of esbuild@^0.27.0 || ^0.28.0.

2. Exact Changes Made

Made the minimal, non-breaking update without downgrading Vite, removing Tailwind CSS, or using --force / --legacy-peer-deps:

  • In package.json:

    code Diff
    -    "esbuild": "^0.25.0",
+    "esbuild": "^0.28.0",

  • package-lock.json: Cleanly regenerated via standard npm install.

3. Verification & Build Results

  • npm install: Succeeded cleanly (exit code 0) with 0 vulnerabilities and 0 peer conflicts.

  • Dependency Deduping (npm ls esbuild): All packages (root, vite@8.3.7, and tsx@4.23.15) cleanly resolve to esbuild@0.28.2.

  • npm run build: Succeeded in 1.06s (dist/ created with CSS and JS bundles).

  • npm test: All 97 unit and integration tests passed (100%).

  • TypeScript Lint (tsc --noEmit): Succeeded with 0 errors.

The SmartRegister application has been hardened for Learner Dashboard privacy and role-based data protection while preserving the existing layout, branding, navigation, and attendance/GPS workflows.

Summary of Changes

  1. Role-Scoped State & Credential Sanitization

    • Passwords are stripped from currentUser across login, registration, password reset, and profile update flows, as well as from exposed users lists.

    • When signed in as a learner, context selectors restrict exposed data strictly to:

      • Own profile details and attendance history (with raw GPS coordinates omitted).

      • Own absence requests.

      • Active, approved peer profiles only for the Learner Directory (excluding passwords, peer phone numbers, peer learner numbers, pending registrations, and admin accounts).

    • Pending registration queues, audit logs, simulated time controls, simulated GPS presets, schedule overrides, and workplace configuration updates are restricted to administrators.

    • Non-admin consumers receive masked coordinates (0, 0) in exposed workplace/location state while internal attendance verification continues operating securely.

  2. Learner UI Privacy Cleanup

    • Learner Dashboard & Attendance Terminal: Removed raw workplace GPS coordinates, geofence radius/accuracy threshold configuration details, and technical Geolocation API parameters while retaining place-name feedback (DynamicDNA Campus. or reverse-geocoded place name), live GPS accuracy in metres, clear error messages, and location retry controls.

    • Attendance History: Replaced raw GPS distance numbers with clean verification labels (Verified (Office)).

    • Learner Profile: Updated internal enrolment wording (Official Enrolment Details:) while keeping only the learner's own permitted profile and professional directory fields.

  3. Backend API Authorization & Coordinate Stripping

    • Enforced strict administrator authorization (HTTP 403) across admin attendance and report endpoints when the caller is unauthenticated or holds a non-admin role.

    • Enforced learner self-access boundaries (HTTP 403 on cross-learner access) for viewing today's attendance, clocking in, clocking out, and resetting today's session.

    • Stripped raw clockInLatitude, clockInLongitude, clockOutLatitude, and clockOutLongitude fields from learner-facing attendance API responses, and ensured admin record responses omit user password fields.

Verification Results

  • HTTP RBAC & Learner Render Audit: Verified HTTP 403 enforcement for unauthenticated/cross-learner/non-admin requests, coordinate stripping on learner API responses, and clean SSR rendering of Learner Dashboard and Learner views with zero exposed credentials, raw GPS coordinates, or peer private records.

7. SECURITY AND PRIVACY

  • Never expose administrator credentials to learners.

SmartRegister has been updated to simplify the Learner Dashboard, remove the specified learner-facing features, and remove DynamicDNA branding across both the Learner and Admin Dashboards while keeping the login page and administrative functionality intact.

Summary of Changes

  1. Learner Dashboard & Navigation Cleanup

    • Removed Learner Directory, Report Absence / Sick Letter reporting, Verify Location button/interface, and GPS API sections and telemetry explanations from the Learner Dashboard, Attendance Terminal, Sidebar, Mobile Navigation, Header dropdown, and Learner route switch.

    • Updated Attendance History table headers to show Work Arrangement (Office / WFH) without GPS verification wording, and updated Learner Profile text to remove Learner Directory references.

    • Preserved the personal welcome header, today's attendance status, manual Clock In and Clock Out actions, personal Attendance History, Profile & Account Settings, and Sign Out.

  2. DynamicDNA Branding Removal (Dashboards Only)

    • Removed the DynamicDNA logo and "DynamicDNA | DVT Learnership Programme" heading from the shared dashboard header, Learner screens, dashboard footers, Admin Attendance Reports (screen header and printable A4 header), Admin Register Downloads header, and the Admin learner creation modal, keeping SmartRegister branding intact.

    • Left the login, registration, and password reset pages unchanged with their existing DynamicDNA branding and authentication flows.

  3. Development Status & Project Ownership

    • Added the IN DEVELOPMENT status indicator strip at the top of the application.

    • Preserved project ownership and copyright attribution (SmartRegister – School Register Management System, Zwavhudi Travor Tshivhase, © 2026 Zwavhudi Travor Tshivhase) in README.md, COPYRIGHT.md, and the application footer.

  4. Admin Dashboard Preservation

    • Retained all existing Admin authentication, learner management, attendance management, attendance reports, schedule management, and system controls.

Verification

  • Automated Tests (npm test): All 106 assertions passed across attendanceValidation, adminReports, reverseGeocoding, and passwordReset.

  • UI & Functional Checks: Verified rendered output of login, shared layout, Learner screens, and Admin screens for logo/feature removal, presence of the IN DEVELOPMENT banner, and working manual Clock-In/Clock-Out rules.

  • Build & Type Check: Both compile_applet and lint_applet (tsc --noEmit) succeeded with zero errors.
